profile.tagline: Frontend developer building fast, accessible web apps with React, TypeScript and Next.js — and growing into the backend.
profile.availability: I'm currently open to new opportunities. Whether you have a project in mind or just want to connect — my inbox is always open.

paragraphs: I'm a frontend developer with around three years of experience building web applications in React, TypeScript and Next.js. I care about clean component architecture, accessible interfaces and the small details that make a product feel fast.

Lately I have been growing on the backend side — building APIs with NestJS, exploring role-based access control, and learning Spring Boot. I also enjoy headless setups like WordPress + Next.js with REST and GraphQL.
